verses.en: The word of the Lord that came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel fut adressée à Michée, de Moréscheth, au temps de Jotham, d''Achaz, d''Ezéchias, rois de Juda, prophétie sur Samarie et Jérusalem.
verses.am: በይሁዳ ነገሥታት በኢዮአታምና በአካዝ በሕዝቅያስም ዘመን ወደ ሞሬታዊው ወደ ሚክያስ የመጣው፥ ስለ ሰማርያና ስለ ኢየሩሳሌም ያየው፥ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: Hear, all ye people; hearken, O earth, and all that therein is: and let the Lord God be witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.
verses.fr: Ecoutez, vous tous, peuples! Sois attentive, terre, et ce qui est en toi! Que le Seigneur, l''Eternel, soit témoin contre vous, Le Seigneur qui est dans le palais de sa sainteté!
verses.am: እናንተ አሕዛብ ሁሉ፥ ስሙ፤ ምድርም ሙላዋም ታድምጥ፤ ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም፥ እርሱም በቅዱስ መቅደሱ የሆነ ጌታ፥ ይመስክርባችሁ።

verses.en: For, behold, the Lord cometh forth out of his place, and will come down, and tread upon the high places of the earth.
verses.fr: Car voici, l''Eternel sort de sa demeure, Il descend, il marche sur les hauteurs de la terre.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር ከስፍራው ይወጣል፥ ወርዶም በምድር ከፍታዎች ላይ ይረግጣል።

verses.en: And the mountains shall be molten under him, and the valleys shall be cleft, as wax before the fire, and as the waters that are poured down a steep place.
verses.fr: Sous lui les montagnes se fondent, Les vallées s''entr''ouvrent, Comme la cire devant le feu, Comme l''eau qui coule sur une pente.
verses.am: ተራሮችም በእሳት ፊት እንዳለ ሰም፥ በገደልም ወርዶ እንደሚፈስስ ውኃ፥ በበታቹ ይቀልጣሉ፥ ሸለቆችም ይሰነጠቃሉ።

verses.en: For the transgression of Jacob is all this, and for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the transgression of Jacob? is it not Samaria? and what are the high places of Judah? are they not Jerusalem?
verses.fr: Et tout cela à cause du crime de Jacob, A cause des péchés de la maison d''Israël! Quel est le crime de Jacob? n''est-ce pas Samarie? Quels sont les hauts lieux de Juda? n''est-ce pas Jérusalem?...
verses.am: ይህ ሁሉ ስለ ያዕቆብ በደልና ስለ እስራኤል ቤት ኃጢአት ነው። የያዕቆብም በደል ምንድር ነው? ሰማርያ አይደለችምን? የይሁዳስ የኮረብታው መስገጃ ምንድር ነው? ኢየሩሳሌም አይደለችምን?

verses.en: Therefore I will make Samaria as an heap of the field, and as plantings of a vineyard: and I will pour down the stones thereof into the valley, and I will discover the foundations thereof.
verses.fr: Je ferai de Samarie un monceau de pierres dans les champs, Un lieu pour planter de la vigne; Je précipiterai ses pierres dans la vallée, Je mettrai à nu ses fondements.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ሰማርያን በሜዳ እንደሚገኝ የድንጋይ ክምር፥ ወይን እንደሚተከልበትም ስፍራ አደርጋታለሁ፤ ድንጋዮችዋንም ወደ ሸለቆ እወረውራለሁ፥ መሠረቶችዋንም እገልጣለሁ።

verses.en: And all the graven images thereof shall be beaten to pieces, and all the hires thereof shall be burned with the fire, and all the idols thereof will I lay desolate: for she gathered it of the hire of an harlot, and they shall return to the hire of an harlot.
verses.fr: Toutes ses images taillées seront brisées, Tous ses salaires impurs seront brûlés au feu, Et je ravagerai toutes ses idoles: Recueillies avec le salaire de la prostitution, Elles deviendront un salaire de prostitutions...
verses.am: የተቀረጹትም ምስሎችዋ ይደቅቃሉ፥ በግልሙትና ያገኘችው ዋጋ ሁሉ በእሳት ይቃጠላል፥ ጣዖታትዋንም ሁሉ አጠፋለሁ፤ በግልሙትና ዋጋ ሰበሰበቻቸው፥ ወደ ግልሙትናም ዋጋ ይመለሳሉና።

verses.en: Therefore I will wail and howl, I will go stripped and naked: I will make a wailing like the dragons, and mourning as the owls.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi je pleurerai, je me lamenterai, Je marcherai déchaussé et nu, Je pousserai des cris comme le chacal, Et des gémissements comme l''autruche.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ነገር ዋይ ብላ ታለቅሳለች፥ ባዶ እግርዋንና ዕራቁትዋን ሆና ትሄዳለች፤ እንደ ቀበሮ ታለቅሳለች፥ እንደ ሰጐንም ዋይ ትላለች፤

verses.en: For her wound is incurable; for it is come unto Judah; he is come unto the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Car sa plaie est douloureuse; Elle s''étend jusqu''à Juda, Elle pénètre jusqu''à la porte de mon peuple, Jusqu''à Jérusalem.
verses.am: ቍስልዋ የማይፈወስ ነውና፤ እስከ ይሁዳም ደርሶአልና፥ ወደ ሕዝቤም በር ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ቀርቦአልና።

verses.en: Declare ye it not at Gath, weep ye not at all: in the house of Aphrah roll thyself in the dust.
verses.fr: Ne l''annoncez point dans Gath, Ne pleurez point dans Acco! Je me roule dans la poussière à Beth Leaphra.
verses.am: በጌት ላይ አታውሩ፤ በአኮ ላይ እንባን አታድርጉ፤ በቤትዓፍራ በትቢያ ላይ ተንከባለሉ።

verses.en: Pass ye away, thou inhabitant of Saphir, having thy shame naked: the inhabitant of Zaanan came not forth in the mourning of Bethezel; he shall receive of you his standing.
verses.fr: Passe, habitante de Schaphir, dans la nudité et la honte! L''habitante de Tsaanan n''ose sortir, Le deuil de Beth-Haëtsel vous prive de son abri.
verses.am: በሻፊር የምትቀመጪ ሆይ፥ በዕራቁትነትሽና በእፍረት እለፊ፤ በጸዓናን የምትቀመጠው አልወጣችም፤ የቤትኤጼል ልቅሶ ከእናንተ ዘንድ መኖሪያውን ይወስዳል።

verses.en: For the inhabitant of Maroth waited carefully for good: but evil came down from the Lord unto the gate of Jerusalem.
verses.fr: L''habitante de Maroth tremble pour son salut, Car le malheur est descendu de la part de l''Eternel Jusqu''à la porte de Jérusalem.
verses.am: ክፉ ነገር ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ እስከ ኢየሩሳሌም በር ድረስ ወርዶአልና በማሮት የምትቀመጠው በጎነትን ትጠባበቃለች።

verses.en: O thou inhabitant of Lachish, bind the chariot to the swift beast: she is the beginning of the sin to the daughter of Zion: for the transgressions of Israel were found in thee.
verses.fr: Attelle les coursiers à ton char, Habitante de Lakisch! Tu as été pour la fille de Sion une première cause de péché, Car en toi se sont trouvés les crimes d''Israël.
verses.am: በለኪሶ የምትቀመጪ ሆይ፥ ሰረገላውን ለፈረስ እሰሪ፤ እርስዋ ለጽዮን ሴት ልጅ የኃጢአት መጀመሪያ ነበረች፤ የእስራኤል በደል በአንቺ ዘንድ ተገኝቶአልና።

verses.en: Therefore shalt thou give presents to Moreshethgath: the houses of Achzib shall be a lie to the kings of Israel.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi tu renonceras à Moréschet-Gath; Les maisons d''Aczib seront une source trompeuse Pour les rois d''Israël.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ትሎት ለሞሬሼትጌት ትሰጪአለሽ፤ የአክዚብ ቤቶች ለእስራኤል ነገሥታት አታላይ ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: Yet will I bring an heir unto thee, O inhabitant of Mareshah: he shall come unto Adullam the glory of Israel.
verses.fr: Je t''amènerai un nouveau maître, habitante de Maréscha; La gloire d''Israël s''en ira jusqu''à Adullam.
verses.am: በመሪሳ የምትቀመጪ ሆይ፥ ወራሽ አመጣብሻለሁ፤ የእስራኤል ክብር ወደ ዓዶላም ይመጣል።

verses.en: Make thee bald, and poll thee for thy delicate children; enlarge thy baldness as the eagle; for they are gone into captivity from thee.
verses.fr: Rase-toi, coupe ta chevelure, A cause de tes enfants chéris! Rends-toi chauve comme l''aigle, Car ils s''en vont en captivité loin de toi!
verses.am: ተማርከው ከአንቺ ዘንድ ወጥተዋልና ስለ ተድላሽ ልጆች ራስሽን ንጪ፥ ጠጕርሽንም ተቈረጪ፤ ቡሃነትሽንም እንደ ንስር አስፊ።

verses.en: Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds! when the morning is light, they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand.
verses.fr: Malheur à ceux qui méditent l''iniquité et qui forgent le mal Sur leur couche! Au point du jour ils l''exécutent, Quand ils ont le pouvoir en main.
verses.am: በመኝታቸው ላይ በደልን ለሚያስቡ ክፋትንም ለሚያደርጉ ወዮላቸው! ኃይል በእጃቸው ነውና ሲነጋ ይፈጽሙታል።

verses.en: And they covet fields, and take them by violence; and houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.
verses.fr: Ils convoitent des champs, et ils s''en emparent, Des maisons, et ils les enlèvent; Ils portent leur violence sur l''homme et sur sa maison, Sur l''homme et sur son héritage.
verses.am: በእርሻው ላይ ይመኛሉ፥ በግዴታም ይይዙታል፤ በቤቶችም ላይ ይመኛሉ፥ ይወስዱአቸውማል፤ ሰውንና ቤቱን፥ ሰውንና ርስቱንም ይነጥቃሉ።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Behold, against this family do I devise an evil, from which ye shall not remove your necks; neither shall ye go haughtily: for this time is evil.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle l''Eternel: Voici, je médite contre cette race un malheur; Vous n''en préserverez pas vos cous, Et vous ne marcherez pas la tête levée, Car ces temps seront mauvais.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ በዚህ ወገን ላይ በክፉ አስባለሁ፥ ከዚያም አንገታችሁን አታነሡም፤ ዘመኑም ክፉ ነውና ቀጥ ብላችሁ አትሄዱም።

verses.en: In that day shall one take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, and say, We be utterly spoiled: he hath changed the portion of my people: how hath he removed it from me! turning away he hath divided our fields.
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, on fera de vous un sujet de sarcasme, On poussera des cris lamentables, On dira: Nous sommes entièrement dévastés! Il donne à d''autres la part de mon peuple! Eh quoi! il me l''enlève! Il distribue nos champs à l''ennemi!...
verses.am: በዚያ ቀን በምሳሌ ይመስሉባችኋል፥ በጽኑ ልቅሶም ያለቅሱላችኋል፤ እነርሱም። ፈጽመን ጠፍተናል፤ የሕዝቤን እድል ፈንታ ይሰፍራል፥ እርሱንም የሚከለክል የለም፤ እርሻችንን ለዓመፀኞች ይከፍላል ይላሉ።

verses.en: Therefore thou shalt have none that shall cast a cord by lot in the congregation of the Lord.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi tu n''auras personne Qui étende le cordeau sur un lot, Dans l''assemblée de l''Eternel. -
verses.am: ስለዚህ በእግዚአብሔር ጉባኤ መካከል በዕጣ ገመድ የሚጥል አይኖርህም።

verses.en: Prophesy ye not, say they to them that prophesy: they shall not prophesy to them, that they shall not take shame.
verses.fr: Ne prophétisez pas! disent-ils. Qu''on ne prophétise pas de telles choses! Les invectives n''ont point de fin! -
verses.am: ትንቢት አትናገሩ ብለው ይናገራሉ፤ በእነዚህ ላይ ትንቢት አይናገሩም፥ ስድብም አይርቅም።

verses.en: O thou that art named the house of Jacob, is the spirit of the Lord straitened? are these his doings? do not my words do good to him that walketh uprightly?
verses.fr: Oses-tu parler ainsi, maison de Jacob? L''Eternel est-il prompt à s''irriter? Est-ce là sa manière d''agir? Mes paroles ne sont-elles pas favorables A celui qui marche avec droiture?
verses.am: የያዕቆብ ቤት የተባልህ ሆይ፥ በውኑ የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ የማይታገሥ ነውን? ወይስ ሥራው እንደዚች ናትን? ቃሌስ በቅን ለሚሄድ በጎነት አያደርግምን?

verses.en: Even of late my people is risen up as an enemy: ye pull off the robe with the garment from them that pass by securely as men averse from war.
verses.fr: Depuis longtemps on traite mon peuple en ennemi; Vous enlevez le manteau de dessus les vêtements De ceux qui passent avec sécurité En revenant de la guerre.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከቅርብ ጊዜ ጀምሮ ሕዝቤ እንደ ጠላት ሆኖ ተነሥቶአል፤ ቀሚስንና መጐናጸፊያን ገፈፋችሁ፤ ሳይፈሩም፤ የሚያልፉትን ከሰልፍ እንደሚመለሱ አደረጋችኋቸው።

verses.en: The women of my people have ye cast out from their pleasant houses; from their children have ye taken away my glory for ever.
verses.fr: Vous chassez de leurs maisons chéries les femmes de mon peuple, Vous ôtez pour toujours ma parure à leurs enfants.
verses.am: የሕዝቤንም ሴቶች ከተሸለሙ ቤቶቻቸው አሳደዳችኋቸው፤ ከሕፃናቶቻቸውም ክብሬን ለዘላለም ወሰዳችሁ።

verses.en: Arise ye, and depart; for this is not your rest: because it is polluted, it shall destroy you, even with a sore destruction.
verses.fr: Levez-vous, marchez! car ce n''est point ici un lieu de repos; A cause de la souillure, il y aura des douleurs, des douleurs violentes.
verses.am: በዚህ ዕረፍት የላችሁምና ተነሥታችሁ ሂዱ፤ በርኵሰት ምክንያት ክፉ ጥፋት ታጠፋችኋለች።

verses.en: If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people.
verses.fr: Si un homme court après le vent et débite des mensonges: Je vais te prophétiser sur le vin, sur les boissons fortes! Ce sera pour ce peuple un prophète.
verses.am: ነፋስንም ተከትሎ። ስለ ወይን ጠጅና ስለ ስካር ትንቢት እናገርልሃለሁ ብሎ ሐሰትን የሚናገር ሰው ቢኖር እርሱ ለዚህ ሕዝብ ነቢይ ይሆናል።

verses.en: I will surely assemble, O Jacob, all of thee; I will surely gather the remnant of Israel; I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as the flock in the midst of their fold: they shall make great noise by reason of the multitude of men.
verses.fr: Je te rassemblerai tout entier, ô Jacob! Je rassemblerai les restes d''Israël, Je les réunirai comme les brebis d''une bergerie, Comme le troupeau dans son pâturage; Il y aura un grand bruit d''hommes.
verses.am: ያዕቆብ ሆይ፥ ሁለንተናህን ፈጽሞ እሰበስባለሁ፥ የእስራኤልንም ቅሬታ ፈጽሞ አከማቻለሁ፤ እንደ ባሶራ በጎችና እንደ መንጋ በማሰማርያቸው ውስጥ በአንድነት አኖራቸዋለሁ፤ ከሰው ብዛት የተነሣ ድምፃቸውን ያሰማሉ።

verses.en: The breaker is come up before them: they have broken up, and have passed through the gate, and are gone out by it: and their king shall pass before them, and the Lord on the head of them.
verses.fr: Celui qui fera la brèche montera devant eux; Ils feront la brèche, franchiront la porte et en sortiront; Leur roi marchera devant eux, Et l''Eternel sera à leur tête.
verses.am: ሰባሪው በፊታቸው ወጥቶአል፤ እነርሱም ሰብረው ወደ በሩ አልፈዋል፥ በእርሱም በኩል ወጥተዋል፤ ንጉሣቸውም በፊታቸው አልፎአል፥ እግዚአብሔርም በራሳቸው ላይ ነው።

verses.en: And I said, Hear, I pray you, O heads of Jacob, and ye princes of the house of Israel; Is it not for you to know judgment?
verses.fr: Je dis: Ecoutez, chefs de Jacob, Et princes de la maison d''Israël! N''est-ce pas à vous à connaître la justice?
verses.am: እንዲህም አልሁ። የያዕቆብ አለቆችና የእስራኤል ቤት ገዦች ሆይ፥ እባካችሁ ስሙኝ፤ ፍርድን ታውቁ ዘንድ አይገባችሁምን?

verses.en: Who hate the good, and love the evil; who pluck off their skin from off them, and their flesh from off their bones;
verses.fr: Vous haïssez le bien et vous aimez le mal; Vous leur arrachez la peau et la chair de dessus les os.
verses.am: መልካሙን ጠልታችኋል፥ ክፉውንም ወድዳችኋል፤ ቁርበታቸውን ገፍፋችኋቸዋል፥ ሥጋቸውንም ከአጥንታቸው ለያይታችኋል፤

verses.en: Who also eat the flesh of my people, and flay their skin from off them; and they break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as flesh within the caldron.
verses.fr: Ils dévorent la chair de mon peuple, Lui arrachent la peau, Et lui brisent les os; Ils le mettent en pièces comme ce qu''on cuit dans un pot, Comme de la viande dans une chaudière.
verses.am: የሕዝቤን ሥጋ በልታችኋል፥ ቁርበታቸውንም ገፍፋችኋቸዋል፥ አጥንታቸውንም ሰብራችኋል፤ ለአፍላል እንደሚሆን ሥጋ ለድስትም እንደሚሆን ሙዳ ቈራረጣችኋቸው።

verses.en: Then shall they cry unto the Lord, but he will not hear them: he will even hide his face from them at that time, as they have behaved themselves ill in their doings.
verses.fr: Alors ils crieront vers l''Eternel, Mais il ne leur répondra pas; Il leur cachera sa face en ce temps-là, Parce qu''ils ont fait de mauvaises actions.
verses.am: የዚያን ጊዜ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይጮኻሉ፥ እርሱም አይሰማቸውም፤ ሥራቸውንም ክፉ አድርገዋልና በዚያን ጊዜ ፊቱን ከእነርሱ ይሰውራል።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord concerning the prophets that make my people err, that bite with their teeth, and cry, Peace; and he that putteth not into their mouths, they even prepare war against him.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel sur les prophètes qui égarent mon peuple, Qui annoncent la paix si leurs dents ont quelque chose à mordre, Et qui publient la guerre si on ne leur met rien dans la bouche:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቤን ስለሚያስቱ ነቢያት እንዲህ ይላል፤ በጥርሳቸው ሲነክሱ በሰላም ይሰብካሉ፤ በአፋቸው ግን አንዳች በማይሰጥ ሰው ላይ ሰልፍን ያስቡበታል።

verses.en: Therefore night shall be unto you, that ye shall not have a vision; and it shall be dark unto you, that ye shall not divine; and the sun shall go down over the prophets, and the day shall be dark over them.
verses.fr: A cause de cela, vous aurez la nuit..., et plus de visions! Vous aurez les ténèbres..., et plus d''oracles! Le soleil se couchera sur ces prophètes, Le jour s''obscurcira sur eux.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ሌሊት ይሆንባችኋል እንጂ ራእይ አይሆንላችሁም፤ ጨለማም ይሆንባችኋል እንጂ አታምዋርቱም፤ ፀሐይም በነቢያት ላይ ትገባለች፥ ቀኑም ይጠቁርባቸዋል።

verses.en: Then shall the seers be ashamed, and the diviners confounded: yea, they shall all cover their lips; for there is no answer of God.
verses.fr: Les voyants seront confus, les devins rougiront, Tous se couvriront la barbe; Car Dieu ne répondra pas.
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔርም ዘንድ መልስ የለምና ባለ ራእዩቹ ያፍራሉ፥ ምዋርተኞችም ይዋረዳሉ፤ ሁሉም ከንፈራቸውን ይሸፍናሉ።

verses.en: But truly I am full of power by the spirit of the Lord, and of judgment, and of might, to declare unto Jacob his transgression, and to Israel his sin.
verses.fr: Mais moi, je suis rempli de force, de l''esprit de l''Eternel, Je suis rempli de justice et de vigueur, Pour faire connaître à Jacob son crime, Et à Israël son péché.
verses.am: እኔ ግን በደሉን ለያዕቆብ፥ ኃጢአቱንም ለእስራኤል እነግር ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ ኃይልንና ፍርድን ብርታትንም ተሞልቻለሁ።

verses.en: Hear this, I pray you, ye heads of the house of Jacob, and princes of the house of Israel, that abhor judgment, and pervert all equity.
verses.fr: Ecoutez donc ceci, chefs de la maison de Jacob, Et princes de la maison d''Israël, Vous qui avez en horreur la justice, Et qui pervertissez tout ce qui est droit,
verses.am: ፍርድን የምትጠሉ ቅን ነገርንም ሁሉ የምታጣምሙ እናንተ የያዕቆብ ቤት አለቆችና የእስራኤል ቤት ገዦች ሆይ፥ እባካችሁ ይህን ስሙ።

verses.en: They build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.
verses.fr: Vous qui bâtissez Sion avec le sang, Et Jérusalem avec l''iniquité!
verses.am: ጽዮንን በደም፥ ኢየሩሳሌምንም በኃጢአት ይሠራሉ።

verses.en: The heads thereof judge for reward, and the priests thereof teach for hire, and the prophets thereof divine for money: yet will they lean upon the Lord, and say, Is not the Lord among us? none evil can come upon us.
verses.fr: Ses chefs jugent pour des présents, Ses sacrificateurs enseignent pour un salaire, Et ses prophètes prédisent pour de l''argent; Et ils osent s''appuyer sur l''Eternel, ils disent: L''Eternel n''est-il pas au milieu de nous? Le malheur ne nous atteindra pas.
verses.am: አለቆችዋ በጉቦ ይፈርዳሉ፥ ካህናቶችዋም በዋጋ ያስተምራሉ፥ ነቢያቶችዋም በገንዘብ ያምዋርታሉ፤ ከዚህም ጋር። እግዚአብሔር በመካከላችን አይደለምን? ክፉ ነገር ምንም አይመጣብንም እያሉ በእግዚአብሔር ይታመናሉ።

verses.en: Therefore shall Zion for your sake be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of the forest.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi, à cause de vous, Sion sera labourée comme un champ, Jérusalem deviendra un monceau de pierres, Et la montagne du temple une sommité couverte de bois.
verses.am: ስለዚህ በእናንተ ምክንያት ጽዮን እንደ እርሻ ትታረሳለች፥ ኢየሩሳሌምም የድንጋይ ክምር ትሆናለች፥ የቤቱም ተራራ እንደ ዱር ከፍታ ይሆናል።

verses.en: But in the last days it shall come to pass, that the mountain of the house of the Lord shall be established in the top of the mountains, and it shall be exalted above the hills; and people shall flow unto it.
verses.fr: Il arrivera, dans la suite des temps, Que la montagne de la maison de l''Eternel Sera fondée sur le sommet des montagnes, Qu''elle s''élèvera par-dessus les collines, Et que les peuples y afflueront.
verses.am: በመጨረሻውም ዘመን የእግዚአብሔር ቤት ተራራ በተራሮች ራስ ላይ ጸንቶ ይቆማል፥ ከኮረብቶችም በላይ ከፍ ከፍ ይላል፤ አሕዛብም ወደ እርሱ ይጐርፋሉ።

verses.en: And many nations shall come, and say, Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall go forth of Zion, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Des nations s''y rendront en foule, et diront: Venez, et montons à la montagne de l''Eternel, A la maison du Dieu de Jacob, Afin qu''il nous enseigne ses voies, Et que nous marchions dans ses sentiers. Car de Sion sortira la loi, Et de Jérusalem la parole de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ከጽዮን ሕግ፥ ከኢየሩሳሌምም የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ይወጣልና ብዙዎች አሕዛብ ሄደው። ኑ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ተራራ፥ ወደ ያዕቆብ አምላክ ቤት እንውጣ፤ እርሱም መንገዱን ያስተምረናል፥ በፍለጋውም እንሄዳለን ይላሉ።

verses.en: And he shall judge among many people, and rebuke strong nations afar off; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up a sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
verses.fr: Il sera le juge d''un grand nombre de peuples, L''arbitre de nations puissantes, lointaines. De leurs glaives ils forgeront des hoyaux, Et de leurs lances des serpes; Une nation ne tirera plus l''épée contre une autre, Et l''on n''apprendra plus la guerre.
verses.am: በብዙዎችም አሕዛብ መካከል ይፈርዳል፥ በሩቅም ባሉ በብርቱዎች አሕዛብ ላይ ይበይናል፤ ሰይፋቸውንም ማረሻ፥ ጦራቸውንም ማጭድ ለማድረግ ይቀጠቅጣሉ፤ ሕዝብም በሕዝብ ላይ ሰይፍ አያነሣም ከእንግዲህም ወዲህ ሰልፍ አይማሩም።

verses.en: But they shall sit every man under his vine and under his fig tree; and none shall make them afraid: for the mouth of the Lord of hosts hath spoken it.
verses.fr: Ils habiteront chacun sous sa vigne et sous son figuier, Et il n''y aura personne pour les troubler; Car la bouche de l''Eternel des armées a parlé.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ የእግዚአብሔር አፍም ተናግሮአልና ሰው እያንዳንዱ ከወይኑና ከበለሱ በታች ይቀመጣል፥ የሚያስፈራውም የለም።

verses.en: For all people will walk every one in the name of his god, and we will walk in the name of the Lord our God for ever and ever.
verses.fr: Tandis que tous les peuples marchent, chacun au nom de son dieu, Nous marcherons, nous, au nom de l''Eternel, notre Dieu, A toujours et à perpétuité.
verses.am: ሕዝብም ሁሉ እያንዳንዱ በየአምላኩ ስም ይሄዳል፥ እኛም በአምላካችን በእግዚአብሔር ስም ለዘላለም እንሄዳለን።

verses.en: In that day, saith the Lord, will I assemble her that halteth, and I will gather her that is driven out, and her that I have afflicted;
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, dit l''Eternel, je recueillerai les boiteux, Je rassemblerai ceux qui étaient chassés, Ceux que j''avais maltraités.
verses.am: በዚያ ቀን አንካሳይቱን እሰበስባለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ የባከነችውንና ያስጨነቅኋትንም አከማቻለሁ፤

verses.en: And I will make her that halted a remnant, and her that was cast far off a strong nation: and the Lord shall reign over them in mount Zion from henceforth, even for ever.
verses.fr: Des boiteux je ferai un reste, De ceux qui étaient chassés une nation puissante; Et l''Eternel régnera sur eux, à la montagne de Sion, Dès lors et pour toujours.
verses.am: አንካሳይቱንም ለቅሬታ፥ ወደ ሩቅም የተጣለችውን ለብርቱ ሕዝብ አደርጋታለሁ፤ ከዚያም ወዲያ እስከ ዘላለም ድረስ እግዚአብሔር በጽዮን ተራራ በእነርሱ ላይ ይነግሣል።

verses.en: And thou, O tower of the flock, the strong hold of the daughter of Zion, unto thee shall it come, even the first dominion; the kingdom shall come to the daughter of Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Et toi, tour du troupeau, colline de la fille de Sion, A toi viendra, à toi arrivera l''ancienne domination, Le royaume de la fille de Jérusalem.
verses.am: አንተም የመንጋ ግንብ ሆይ፥ የጽዮን ሴት ልጅ አምባ፥ ወደ አንተ ትመጣለች፤ የቀደመችው ግዛት፥ የኢየሩሳሌም ሴት ልጅ መንግሥት ትደርሳለች።

verses.en: Now why dost thou cry out aloud? is there no king in thee? is thy counsellor perished? for pangs have taken thee as a woman in travail.
verses.fr: Pourquoi maintenant pousses-tu des cris? N''as-tu point de roi, plus de conseiller, Pour que la douleur te saisisse comme une femme qui accouche?
verses.am: አሁንስ ለምን ትጮኺአለሽ? እንደምትወልድ ሴት ምጥ የደረሰብሽ፥ ንጉሥ ስለሌለሽ ነውን? ወይስ መካሪ ስለ ጠፋብሽ ነውን?

verses.en: Be in pain, and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail: for now shalt thou go forth out of the city, and thou shalt dwell in the field, and thou shalt go even to Babylon; there shalt thou be delivered; there the Lord shall redeem thee from the hand of thine enemies.
verses.fr: Fille de Sion, souffre et gémis comme une femme qui accouche! Car maintenant tu sortiras de la ville et tu habiteras dans les champs, Et tu iras jusqu''à Babylone; Là tu seras délivrée, C''est là que l''Eternel te rachètera de la main de tes ennemis.
verses.am: የጽዮን ልጅ ሆይ፥ እንደምትወልድ ሴት አምጠሽ ውለጂ፤ አሁን ከከተማ ትወጫለሽና፥ በሜዳም ትቀመጫለሽ፥ ወደ ባቢሎንም ትደርሻለሽ፤ በዚያም ያድንሻል፥ በዚያም እግዚአብሔር ከጠላቶችሽ እጅ ይቤዥሻል።

verses.en: Now also many nations are gathered against thee, that say, Let her be defiled, and let our eye look upon Zion.
verses.fr: Maintenant plusieurs nations se sont rassemblées contre toi: Qu''elle soit profanée, disent-elles, Et que nos yeux se rassasient dans Sion!
verses.am: አሁንም። ርኩስ ትሁን፥ ዓይናችንም በጽዮን ላይ ይይ የሚሉ ብዙ አሕዛብ በአንቺ ላይ ተሰብስበዋል።

verses.en: But they know not the thoughts of the Lord, neither understand they his counsel: for he shall gather them as the sheaves into the floor.
verses.fr: Mais elles ne connaissent pas les pensées de l''Eternel, Elles ne comprennent pas ses desseins, Elles ignorent qu''il les a rassemblées comme des gerbes dans l''aire.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የእግዚአብሔርን አሳብ አያውቁም፥ ምክሩንም አያስተውሉም፤ እንደ ነዶ ወደ አውድማ አከማችቶአቸዋልና።

verses.en: Arise and thresh, O daughter of Zion: for I will make thine horn iron, and I will make thy hoofs brass: and thou shalt beat in pieces many people: and I will consecrate their gain unto the Lord, and their substance unto the Lord of the whole earth.
verses.fr: Fille de Sion, lève-toi et foule! Je te ferai une corne de fer et des ongles d''airain, Et tu broieras des peuples nombreux; Tu consacreras leurs biens à l''Eternel, Leurs richesses au Seigneur de toute la terre.
verses.am: የጽዮን ልጅ ሆይ፥ ቀንድሽን ብረት፥ ጥፍርሽንም ናስ አደርጋለሁና ተነሺ አሂጂ፤ ብዙ አሕዛብንም ታደቅቂአለሽ፤ ትርፋቸውንም ለእግዚአብሔር፥ ሀብታቸውንም ለምድር ሁሉ ጌታ ትቀድሻለሽ።

verses.en: Now gather thyself in troops, O daughter of troops: he hath laid siege against us: they shall smite the judge of Israel with a rod upon the cheek.
verses.fr: Maintenant, fille de troupes, rassemble tes troupes! On nous assiège; Avec la verge on frappe sur la joue le juge d''Israël.
verses.am: የጭፍሮች ሴት ልጅ ሆይ፥ ጭፍሮችሽን አሁን ሰብስቢ፤ ከብቦ አስጨንቆናል፤ የእስራኤልን ፈራጅ ጕንጩን በበትር ይመታሉ።

verses.en: But thou, Bethlehem Ephratah, though thou be little among the thousands of Judah, yet out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.
verses.fr: Et toi, Bethléhem Ephrata, Petite entre les milliers de Juda, De toi sortira pour moi Celui qui dominera sur Israël, Et dont l''origine remonte aux temps anciens, Aux jours de l''éternité.
verses.am: አንቺም ቤተ ልሔም ኤፍራታ ሆይ፥ አንቺ በይሁዳ አእላፋት መካከል ትሆኚ ዘንድ ታናሽ ነሽ፤ ከአንቺ ግን አወጣጡ ከቀድሞ ጀምሮ ከዘላለም የሆነ፥ በእስራኤልም ላይ ገዥ የሚሆን ይወጣልኛል።

verses.en: Therefore will he give them up, until the time that she which travaileth hath brought forth: then the remnant of his brethren shall return unto the children of Israel.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi il les livrera Jusqu''au temps où enfantera celle qui doit enfanter, Et le reste de ses frères Reviendra auprès des enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ወላጂቱ እስከምትወልድበት ጊዜ ድረስ አሳልፎ ይሰጣቸዋል፤ የቀሩትም ወንድሞቹ ወደ እስራኤል ልጆች ይመለሳሉ።

verses.en: And he shall stand and feed in the strength of the Lord, in the majesty of the name of the Lord his God; and they shall abide: for now shall he be great unto the ends of the earth.
verses.fr: Il se présentera, et il gouvernera avec la force de l''Eternel, Avec la majesté du nom de l''Eternel, son Dieu: Et ils auront une demeure assurée, Car il sera glorifié jusqu''aux extrémités de la terre.
verses.am: እርሱም ይቆማል፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ኃይል በአምላኩ በእግዚአብሔር ስም ግርማ መንጋውን ይጠብቃል፤ እነርሱም ይኖራሉ፤ እርሱ አሁን እስከ ምድር ዳርቻ ድረስ ታላቅ ይሆናልና።

verses.en: And this man shall be the peace, when the Assyrian shall come into our land: and when he shall tread in our palaces, then shall we raise against him seven shepherds, and eight principal men.
verses.fr: C''est lui qui ramènera la paix. Lorsque l''Assyrien viendra dans notre pays, Et qu''il pénétrera dans nos palais, Nous ferons lever contre lui sept pasteurs Et huit princes du peuple.
verses.am: ይህም ለሰላም ይሆናል፤ አሦራዊውም ወደ አገራችን በገባ ጊዜ፥ ምድራችንንም በረገጠ ጊዜ ሰባት እረኞችና ስምንት አለቆች እናስነሣበታለን።

verses.en: And they shall waste the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in the entrances thereof: thus shall he deliver us from the Assyrian, when he cometh into our land, and when he treadeth within our borders.
verses.fr: Ils feront avec l''épée leur pâture du pays d''Assyrie Et du pays de Nimrod au dedans de ses portes. Il nous délivrera ainsi de l''Assyrien, Lorsqu''il viendra dans notre pays, Et qu''il pénétrera sur notre territoire.
verses.am: የአሦርንም አገር በሰይፍ፥ የናምሩድንም አገር በመግቢያው ውስጥ ያፈርሳሉ፤ አሦራዊውም ወደ አገራችን በገባ ጊዜ፥ ዳርቾቻችንንም በረገጠ ጊዜ እርሱ ይታደገናል።

verses.en: And the remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many people as a dew from the Lord, as the showers upon the grass, that tarrieth not for man, nor waiteth for the sons of men.
verses.fr: Le reste de Jacob sera au milieu des peuples nombreux Comme une rosée qui vient de l''Eternel, Comme des gouttes d''eau sur l''herbe: Elles ne comptent pas sur l''homme, Elles ne dépendent pas des enfants des hommes.
verses.am: የያዕቆብም ቅሬታ በብዙ አሕዛብ መካከል ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ እንደሚወርድ ጠል፥ በሣር ላይ እንደሚወድ ካፊያ፤ ሰውንም እንደማይጠብቅ፥ የሰውንም ልጆች ተስፋ እንደማያደርግ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And the remnant of Jacob shall be among the Gentiles in the midst of many people as a lion among the beasts of the forest, as a young lion among the flocks of sheep: who, if he go through, both treadeth down, and teareth in pieces, and none can deliver.
verses.fr: Le reste de Jacob sera parmi les nations, Au milieu des peuples nombreux, Comme un lion parmi les bêtes de la forêt, Comme un lionceau parmi les troupeaux de brebis: Lorsqu''il passe, il foule et déchire, Et personne ne délivre.
verses.am: በዱር አራዊትም መካከል እንዳለ አንበሳ፥ በበጎች መንጋም መካከል አልፎ እንደሚረግጥ፥ የሚታደግም ሳይኖር እንደሚነጥቅ እንደ አንበሳ ደቦል፥ እንዲሁ የያዕቆብ ቅሬታ በአሕዛብና በብዙ ወገኖች መካከል ይሆናል።

verses.en: Thine hand shall be lifted up upon thine adversaries, and all thine enemies shall be cut off.
verses.fr: Que ta main se lève sur tes adversaires, Et que tous tes ennemis soient exterminés!
verses.am: እጅህ በጠላቶችህ ላይ ከፍ ከፍ ትበል፥ ጠላቶችህም ሁሉ ይጥፉ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord, that I will cut off thy horses out of the midst of thee, and I will destroy thy chariots:
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, dit l''Eternel, J''exterminerai du milieu de toi tes chevaux, Et je détruirai tes chars;
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን ፈረሶችህን ከመካከልህ አጠፋለሁ፥ ሰረገሎችህንም እሰብራለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤

verses.en: And I will cut off the cities of thy land, and throw down all thy strong holds:
verses.fr: J''exterminerai les villes de ton pays, Et je renverserai toutes tes forteresses;
verses.am: የምድርህንም ከተሞች አጠፋለሁ፥ ምሽጎችህንም ሁሉ አፈርሳለሁ፤

verses.en: And I will cut off witchcrafts out of thine hand; and thou shalt have no more soothsayers:
verses.fr: J''exterminerai de ta main les enchantements, Et tu n''auras plus de magiciens;
verses.am: መተትንም ከእጅህ አጠፋለሁ፥ ምዋርተኞችም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አይሆኑልህም፤

verses.en: Thy graven images also will I cut off, and thy standing images out of the midst of thee; and thou shalt no more worship the work of thine hands.
verses.fr: J''exterminerai du milieu de toi tes idoles et tes statues, Et tu ne te prosterneras plus devant l''ouvrage de tes mains;
verses.am: የተቀረጹትን ምስሎችህንና ሐውልቶችህን ከመካከልህ አጠፋለሁ፥ ለእጅህም ሥራ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አትሰግድም፤

verses.en: And I will pluck up thy groves out of the midst of thee: so will I destroy thy cities.
verses.fr: J''exterminerai du milieu de toi tes idoles d''Astarté, Et je détruirai tes villes.
verses.am: የማምለኪያ ዐፀዶችህንም ከመካከልህ እነቅላለሁ፥ ከተሞችህንም አፈርሳለሁ።

verses.en: And I will execute vengeance in anger and fury upon the heathen, such as they have not heard.
verses.fr: J''exercerai ma vengeance avec colère, avec fureur, sur les nations Qui n''ont pas écouté.
verses.am: ባልሰሙም አሕዛብ ላይ በቍጣና በመዓት እበቀላለሁ።

verses.en: Hear ye now what the Lord saith; Arise, contend thou before the mountains, and let the hills hear thy voice.
verses.fr: Ecoutez donc ce que dit l''Eternel: Lève-toi, plaide devant les montagnes, Et que les collines entendent ta voix!...
verses.am: አሁን። ተነሣ፥ በተራሮችም ፊት ተፋረድ፥ ኮረብቶችም ቃልህን ይስሙ ብሎ እግዚአብሔር የሚለውን ስሙ።

verses.en: Hear ye, O mountains, the Lord's controversy, and ye strong foundations of the earth: for the Lord hath a controversy with his people, and he will plead with Israel.
verses.fr: Ecoutez, montagnes, le procès de l''Eternel, Et vous, solides fondements de la terre! Car l''Eternel a un procès avec son peuple, Il veut plaider avec Israël. -
verses.am: ተራሮች ሆይ፥ ጠንካሮች የምድር መሠረቶችም ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር ከሕዝቡ ጋር ክርክር አለውና፥ ከእስራኤልም ጋር ይፋረዳልና የእግዚአብሔርን ክርክር ስሙ።

verses.en: O my people, what have I done unto thee? and wherein have I wearied thee? testify against me.
verses.fr: Mon peuple, que t''ai-je fait? En quoi t''ai-je fatigué? Réponds-moi!
verses.am: ሕዝቤ ሆይ፥ ምን አድርጌሃለሁ? በምንስ አድክሜሃለሁ? መስክርብኝ።

verses.en: For I brought thee up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed thee out of the house of servants; and I sent before thee Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
verses.fr: Car je t''ai fait monter du pays d''Egypte, Je t''ai délivré de la maison de servitude, Et j''ai envoyé devant toi Moïse, Aaron et Marie.
verses.am: ከግብጽ ምድር አውጥቼሃለሁ፥ ከባርነት ቤትም ተቤዥቼሃለሁ፤ በፊትህም ሙሴንና አሮንን ማርያምንም ልኬልህ ነበር።

verses.en: O my people, remember now what Balak king of Moab consulted, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim unto Gilgal; that ye may know the righteousness of the Lord.
verses.fr: Mon peuple, rappelle-toi ce que projetait Balak, roi de Moab, Et ce que lui répondit Balaam, fils de Beor, De Sittim à Guilgal, Afin que tu reconnaisses les bienfaits de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሕዝቤ ሆይ፥ የሞዓብ ንጉሥ ባላቅ የመከረውን፥ የቢዖርም ልጅ በለዓም የመለሰለትን አሁን አስብ፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም የጽድቅ ሥራ ታውቅ ዘንድ ከሰጢም ጀምሮ እስከ ጌልገላ ድረስ አስብ።

verses.en: Wherewith shall I come before the Lord, and bow myself before the high God? shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves of a year old?
verses.fr: Avec quoi me présenterai-je devant l''Eternel, Pour m''humilier devant le Dieu Très-Haut? Me présenterai-je avec des holocaustes, Avec des veaux d''un an?
verses.am: ምን ይዤ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ፊት ልምጣና በልዑል አምላክ ፊት ልስገድ? የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የአንዱን ዓመት ጥጃ ይዤ በፊቱ ልምጣን?

verses.en: Will the Lord be pleased with thousands of rams, or with ten thousands of rivers of oil? shall I give my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
verses.fr: L''Eternel agréera-t-il des milliers de béliers, Des myriades de torrents d''huile? Donnerai-je pour mes transgressions mon premier-né, Pour le péché de mon âme le fruit de mes entrailles? -
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርስ በሺህ አውራ በጎች ወይስ በእልፍ የዘይት ፈሳሾች ደስ ይለዋልን? ወይስ የበኵር ልጄን ስለ በደሌ፥ የሆዴንም ፍሬ ስለ ነፍሴ ኃጢአት እሰጣለሁን?

verses.en: He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the Lord require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?
verses.fr: On t''a fait connaître, ô homme, ce qui est bien; Et ce que l''Eternel demande de toi, C''est que tu pratiques la justice, Que tu aimes la miséricorde, Et que tu marches humblement avec ton Dieu.
verses.am: ሰው ሆይ፥ መልካሙን ነግሮሃል፤ እግዚአብሔርም ከአንተ ዘንድ የሚሻው ምንድር ነው? ፍርድን ታደርግ ዘንድ፥ ምሕረትንም ትወድድ ዘንድ፥ ከአምላክህም ጋር በትሕትና ትሄድ ዘንድ አይደለምን?

verses.en: The Lord's voice crieth unto the city, and the man of wisdom shall see thy name: hear ye the rod, and who hath appointed it.
verses.fr: La voix de l''Eternel crie à la ville, Et celui qui est sage craindra ton nom. Entendez la verge et celui qui l''envoie!
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ድምፅ ከተማይቱን ይጠራታል፤ ስምህን መፍራት ጥበብ ነው፤ የመቅሠፍትን በትር፥ እርሱንም ያዘጋጀ ማን እንደ ሆነ ስሙ።

verses.en: Are there yet the treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and the scant measure that is abominable?
verses.fr: Y a-t-il encore dans la maison du méchant Des trésors iniques, Et un épha trop petit, objet de malédiction?
verses.am: በውኑ በኃጢአተኛ ቤት የኃጢአት መዝገብ፥ የተጸየፈም ውሽተኛ መስፈሪያ ገና አለ ይሆን?

verses.en: Shall I count them pure with the wicked balances, and with the bag of deceitful weights?
verses.fr: Est-on pur avec des balances fausses, Et avec de faux poids dans le sac?
verses.am: በአባይ ሚዛንና በከረጢት ባለ በተንኰል መመዘኛ ንጹሕ እሆናለሁን?

verses.en: For the rich men thereof are full of violence, and the inhabitants thereof have spoken lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their mouth.
verses.fr: Ses riches sont pleins de violence, Ses habitants profèrent le mensonge, Et leur langue n''est que tromperie dans leur bouche.
verses.am: ባለ ጠጎችዋን ግፍ ሞልቶባቸዋል፤ በእርስዋም የሚኖሩ በሐሰት ተናግረዋል፥ ምላሳቸውም በአፋቸው ውስጥ ተንኰለኛ ነው።

verses.en: Therefore also will I make thee sick in smiting thee, in making thee desolate because of thy sins.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi je te frapperai par la souffrance, Je te ravagerai à cause de tes péchés.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እኔ ደግሞ በክፉ ቍስል መታሁህ፤ ስለ ኃጢአትህም አፈርስሁህ።

verses.en: Thou shalt eat, but not be satisfied; and thy casting down shall be in the midst of thee; and thou shalt take hold, but shalt not deliver; and that which thou deliverest will I give up to the sword.
verses.fr: Tu mangeras sans te rassasier, Et la faim sera au dedans de toi; Tu mettras en réserve et tu ne sauveras pas, Et ce que tu sauveras, je le livrerai à l''épée.
verses.am: ትበላለህ፥ ነገር ግን አትጠግብም፥ ችጋርህም በመካከልህ ይሆናል፤ ትወስዳለህ፥ ነገር ግን አታድንም፤ የምታድነውንም ለሰይፍ እሰጣለሁ።

verses.en: Thou shalt sow, but thou shalt not reap; thou shalt tread the olives, but thou shalt not anoint thee with oil; and sweet wine, but shalt not drink wine.
verses.fr: Tu sèmeras, et tu ne moissonneras pas, Tu presseras l''olive, et tu ne feras pas d''onctions avec l''huile, Tu presseras le moût, et tu ne boiras pas le vin.
verses.am: ትዘራለህ፥ ነገር ግን አታጭድም፤ ወይራውንም ትጨምቃለህ፥ ነገር ግን ዘይቱን አትቀባም፤ ወይኑንም ትጨምቃለህ፥ ነገር ግን የወይን ጠጁን አትጠጣም።

verses.en: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of the house of Ahab, and ye walk in their counsels; that I should make thee a desolation, and the inhabitants thereof an hissing: therefore ye shall bear the reproach of my people.
verses.fr: On observe les coutumes d''Omri Et toute la manière d''agir de la maison d''Achab, Et vous marchez d''après leurs conseils; C''est pourquoi je te livrerai à la destruction, Je ferai de tes habitants un sujet de raillerie, Et vous porterez l''opprobre de mon peuple.
verses.am: አንተን ለጥፋት፥ በእርስዋም የሚኖሩትን ለማፍዋጫ እሰጥ ዘንድ የዘንበሪን ሥርዓትና የአክዓብን ቤት ሥራ ሁሉ ጠብቃችኋል፥ በምክራቸውም ሄዳችኋል፤ የሕዝቤንም ስድብ ትሸከማላችሁ።

verses.en: Woe is me! for I am as when they have gathered the summer fruits, as the grapegleanings of the vintage: there is no cluster to eat: my soul desired the firstripe fruit.
verses.fr: Malheur à moi! car je suis comme à la récolte des fruits, Comme au grappillage après la vendange: Il n''y a point de grappes à manger, Point de ces primeurs que mon âme désire.
verses.am: የዛፍ ፍሬና የወይን ፍሬ ከተለቀሙ በኋላ እንደ ቀረው ቃርሚያ ሆኛለሁና ወዮልኝ! መብል የሚሆን ዘለላ፥ ነፍሴም የተመኘችው በመጀመሪያ የበሰለው በለስ የለም።

verses.en: The good man is perished out of the earth: and there is none upright among men: they all lie in wait for blood; they hunt every man his brother with a net.
verses.fr: L''homme de bien a disparu du pays, Et il n''y a plus de juste parmi les hommes; Ils sont tous en embuscade pour verser le sang, Chacun tend un piège à son frère.
verses.am: ደግ ሰው ከምድር ጠፍቶአል፥ በሰውም መካከል ቅን የለም፤ ሁሉ ደምን ለማፍሰስ ያደባሉ፥ ሰውም ሁሉ ወንድሙን በመረብ ለመያዝ ይከታተለዋል።

verses.en: That they may do evil with both hands earnestly, the prince asketh, and the judge asketh for a reward; and the great man, he uttereth his mischievous desire: so they wrap it up.
verses.fr: Leurs mains sont habiles à faire le mal: Le prince a des exigences, Le juge réclame un salaire, Le grand manifeste son avidité, Et ils font ainsi cause commune.
verses.am: እጆቻቸውን ለክፋት ያነሣሉ፤ አለቃውና ፈራጁ ጉቦን ይፈልጋሉ፥ ትልቁም ሰው እንደ ነፍሱ ምኞት ይናገራል፤ እንዲሁም ክፋትን ይጐነጕናሉ።

verses.en: The best of them is as a brier: the most upright is sharper than a thorn hedge: the day of thy watchmen and thy visitation cometh; now shall be their perplexity.
verses.fr: Le meilleur d''entre eux est comme une ronce, Le plus droit pire qu''un buisson d''épines. Le jour annoncé par tes prophètes, ton châtiment approche. C''est alors qu''ils seront dans la confusion.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም ሁሉ የተሻለው እርሱ እንደ አሜከላ ነው፥ ከሁሉም ቅን የሆነው እንደ ኵርንችት ነው፤ ጠባቆችህ የሚጐበኙበት ቀን መጥቶአል፤ አሁን ይሸበራሉ።

verses.en: Trust ye not in a friend, put ye not confidence in a guide: keep the doors of thy mouth from her that lieth in thy bosom.
verses.fr: Ne crois pas à un ami, Ne te fie pas à un intime; Devant celle qui repose sur ton sein Garde les portes de ta bouche.
verses.am: ባልንጀራን አትመኑ፥ በወዳጅም አትታመኑ፤ የአፍህን ደጅ በብብትህ ከምትተኛው ጠብቅ።

verses.en: For the son dishonoureth the father, the daughter riseth up against her mother, the daughter in law against her mother in law; a man's enemies are the men of his own house.
verses.fr: Car le fils outrage le père, La fille se soulève contre sa mère, La belle-fille contre sa belle-mère; Chacun a pour ennemis les gens de sa maison. -
verses.am: ወንድ ልጅ አባቱን ይንቃልና፥ ሴት ልጅ በእናትዋ ላይ፥ ምራቲቱም በአማትዋ ላይ ትነሣለችና፥ የሰው ጠላቶች የቤቱ ሰዎች ናቸውና።

verses.en: Therefore I will look unto the Lord; I will wait for the God of my salvation: my God will hear me.
verses.fr: Pour moi, je regarderai vers l''Eternel, Je mettrai mon espérance dans le Dieu de mon salut; Mon Dieu m''exaucera.
verses.am: እኔ ግን ወደ እግዚአብሔር እመለከታለሁ፥ የመድኃኒቴንም አምላክ ተስፋ አደርጋለሁ፤ አምላኬም ይሰማኛል።

verses.en: Rejoice not against me, O mine enemy: when I fall, I shall arise; when I sit in darkness, the Lord shall be a light unto me.
verses.fr: Ne te réjouis pas à mon sujet, mon ennemie! Car si je suis tombée, je me relèverai; Si je suis assise dans les ténèbres, L''Eternel sera ma lumière.
verses.am: ጠላቴ ሆይ፥ ብወድቅ እነሣለሁና፥ በጨለማም ብቀመጥ እግዚአብሔር ብርሃን ይሆንልኛልና በእኔ ላይ ደስ አይበልሽ።

verses.en: I will bear the indignation of the Lord, because I have sinned against him, until he plead my cause, and execute judgment for me: he will bring me forth to the light, and I shall behold his righteousness.
verses.fr: Je supporterai la colère de l''Eternel, Puisque j''ai péché contre lui, Jusqu''à ce qu''il défende ma cause et me fasse droit; Il me conduira à la lumière, Et je contemplerai sa justice.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ኃጢአት ሠርቻለሁና እስኪምዋገትልኝ ድረስ፥ ፍርድን ለእኔ እስኪያደርግ ድረስ ቍጣውን እታገሣለሁ። ወደ ብርሃን ያወጣኛል፥ ጽድቅንም አያለሁ።

verses.en: Then she that is mine enemy shall see it, and shame shall cover her which said unto me, Where is the Lord thy God? mine eyes shall behold her: now shall she be trodden down as the mire of the streets.
verses.fr: Mon ennemie le verra et sera couverte de honte, Elle qui me disait: Où est l''Eternel, ton Dieu? Mes yeux se réjouiront à sa vue; Alors elle sera foulée aux pieds comme la boue des rues. -
verses.am: ጠላቴም ታያለች፥ እኔንም። አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ወዴት ነው? ያለች በእፍረት ትከደናለች።

verses.en: In the day that thy walls are to be built, in that day shall the decree be far removed.
verses.fr: Le jour où l''on rebâtira tes murs, Ce jour-là tes limites seront reculées.
verses.am: ዓይኖቼ ይመለከቱአታል፤ አሁን እንደ መንገድ ጭቃ ትረገጣለች። ቅጥርሽ በሚሠራበት በዚያ ቀን ድንበርሽ ትስፋፋለች።

verses.en: In that day also he shall come even to thee from Assyria, and from the fortified cities, and from the fortress even to the river, and from sea to sea, and from mountain to mountain.
verses.fr: En ce jour, on viendra vers toi De l''Assyrie et des villes d''Egypte, De l''Egypte jusqu''au fleuve, D''une mer à l''autre, et d''une montagne à l''autre.
verses.am: በዚያ ቀን ከአሦርና ከግብጽ ከተሞች፥ ከግብጽ እስከ ወንዙ፥ ከባሕርም እስከ ባሕር፥ ከተራራም እስከ ተራራ ድረስ ወደ አንቺ ይመጣሉ።

verses.en: Notwithstanding the land shall be desolate because of them that dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.
verses.fr: Le pays sera dévasté à cause de ses habitants, A cause du fruit de leurs oeuvres.
verses.am: ምድሪቱ ግን በሚኖሩባት በሥራቸው ፍሬ ምክንያት ባድማ ትሆናለች።

verses.en: Feed thy people with thy rod, the flock of thine heritage, which dwell solitarily in the wood, in the midst of Carmel: let them feed in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.
verses.fr: Pais ton peuple avec ta houlette, le troupeau de ton héritage, Qui habite solitaire dans la forêt au milieu du Carmel! Qu''ils paissent sur le Basan et en Galaad, Comme au jour d''autrefois. -
verses.am: በቀርሜሎስ መካከል ባለው ዱር ብቻቸውን የተቀመጡት ሰዎችህ፥ የርስትህን በጎች፥ በበትርህ አግድ፤ እንደ ቀደመውም ዘመን በበሳንና በገለዓድ ይሰማሩ።

verses.en: According to the days of thy coming out of the land of Egypt will I shew unto him marvellous things.
verses.fr: Comme au jour où tu sortis du pays d''Egypte, Je te ferai voir des prodiges. -
verses.am: ከግብጽ ምድር እንደ ወጣህበት ዘመን ተአምራትን አሳያቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: The nations shall see and be confounded at all their might: they shall lay their hand upon their mouth, their ears shall be deaf.
verses.fr: Les nations le verront, et seront confuses, Avec toute leur puissance; Elles mettront la main sur la bouche, Leurs oreilles seront assourdies.
verses.am: አሕዛብ አይተው በጕልበታቸው ሁሉ ያፍራሉ፤ እጃቸውን በአፋቸው ላይ ያኖራሉ፥ ጆሮአቸውም ትደነቍራለች፤

verses.en: They shall lick the dust like a serpent, they shall move out of their holes like worms of the earth: they shall be afraid of the Lord our God, and shall fear because of thee.
verses.fr: Elles lécheront la poussière, comme le serpent, Comme les reptiles de la terre; Elles seront saisies de frayeur hors de leurs forteresses; Elles trembleront devant l''Eternel, notre Dieu, Elles te craindront.
verses.am: እንደ እባብም መሬት ይልሳሉ፥ እንደ ምድርም ተንቀሳቃሾች እየተንቀጠቀጡ ከግንባቸው ይመጣሉ፤ ፈርተውም ወደ አምላካችን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይመጣሉ፥ ስለ አንተም ይፈራሉ።

verses.en: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in mercy.
verses.fr: Quel Dieu est semblable à toi, Qui pardonnes l''iniquité, qui oublies les péchés Du reste de ton héritage? Il ne garde pas sa colère à toujours, Car il prend plaisir à la miséricorde.
verses.am: በደልን ይቅር የሚል፥ የርስቱንም ቅሬታ ዓመፅ የሚያሳልፍ እንደ አንተ ያለ አምላክ ማን ነው? ምሕረትን ይወድዳልና ቍጣውን ለዘላለም አይጠብቅም።

verses.en: He will turn again, he will have compassion upon us; he will subdue our iniquities; and thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
verses.fr: Il aura encore compassion de nous, Il mettra sous ses pieds nos iniquités; Tu jetteras au fond de la mer tous leurs péchés.
verses.am: ተመልሶ ይምረናል፤ ክፋታችንንም ይጠቀጥቃል፥ ኃጢአታችንንም በባሕሩ ጥልቅ ይጥለዋል።

verses.en: Thou wilt perform the truth to Jacob, and the mercy to Abraham, which thou hast sworn unto our fathers from the days of old.
verses.fr: Tu témoigneras de la fidélité à Jacob, De la bonté à Abraham, Comme tu l''as juré à nos pères aux jours d''autrefois.
verses.am: ከቀድሞ ዘመን ጀምረህ ለአባቶቻችን የማልህላቸውን እውነት ለያዕቆብ፥ ምሕረትንም ለአብርሃም ታደርጋለህ።
